releases.body:
## Fixed

- **Skill preview broken on OpenCode 2.1** (#3): OpenCode 2.1 bundles `@opentui/core` 0.6, where `SyntaxStyle.fromStyles()` requires an explicit resource owner. The preview threw while mounting, leaving the dialog half-rendered with no working backdrop — Esc, Ctrl+C and clicking outside could not close it. The owning renderer scene is now passed explicitly, and the preview registers its own modal `escape` binding so dismissal no longer depends on the host's default dialog layer.

## Upgrade note

After updating, **fully quit every opencode process before restarting** — the host does not refresh an already-cached plugin install, so an old process keeps serving the old copy:

    opencode plugin update opencode-skills-tui

- refactor: dedupe server/state scan paths via a shared merge loop
- refactor: drop redundant message/session event subscriptions (part-level events + render-time scan already cover them)
- fix: remove dead in-memory counts mirror (stats dialog already reads from disk)
- docs: README rework (EN/zh-CN)

- Fix: usage stats now live in a dedicated state file (`~/.local/state/opencode/opencode-skills-tui-usage.json`) written read-merge-write on every count, so totals are shared and visible across concurrent OpenCode windows instead of being clobbered by the shared kv snapshot
- `/skills-stats` reads straight from disk, showing other windows counts immediately
- Note for 0.4.x users: counts start fresh once (the old kv keys are no longer read)

- Cleanup pass, no behavior changes: dropped the sourcemap from the package (-54 kB), merged the two usage kv keys into one (`opencode-skills-tui.usage`)
- Note for 0.4.0/0.4.1 users: existing usage counts start fresh once (the old kv keys are no longer read)

- Fix: deleting a session no longer touches usage bookkeeping; counts are global and permanent (session deletion never changes them)
- README: trimmed usage-stats notes to the essentials (both languages)
